pages.title: Anlogic Wiki
pages.applicability: general Anlogic Wiki entry; no NPU deployment contract
explicit_facts: The entry describes DR1M/DR1V development-board, embedded Linux and SDK documentation sections.

pages.chapter_name: D20 NPU应用 / D20.1 NPU简单示例集合
pages.title: D20.1 NPU 简单示例集合
pages.applicability: The page explicitly mentions a DR1M90 Buildroot configuration, but the runnable SD example is explicitly for AD101V20; exact MLK-F3P-CZ02-DR1M90 compatibility is UNKNOWN.
linux_versions: Buildroot defconfig and kernelmenuconfig flow named; exact release string not stated
linux_requirements: Set ANLOGIC_HPF to a generated device/anlogic_dr1m90/hpf/... HPF.
Set ANLOGIC_EXTRA_ROOTFS_DIR to the generated app/npu/rootfs_files directory.
Enable hard_npu_driver, soft_npu_driver and cma_mem_driver in kernelmenuconfig.
The page instructs increasing BR2_TARGET_ROOTFS_EXT2_SIZE from 128M to 300M for this large demo.
build_and_run_facts: Build app/npu to generate rootfs_files, then build the SDK image.
The example uses SD boot and runs scripts from an npu_demo directory.
pages.inference_boundary: The page documents a build flow; it does not establish that the current eMMC image has the matching HPF, kernel modules, runtime or model assets.

pages.chapter_name: D20 NPU应用 / D20.3 USB摄像头和HDMI示例
pages.title: D20.3 基于USB摄像头和HDMI的NPU应用示例
pages.applicability: The page says DR1M90 and uses AD101V20 as the example board; exact MLK-F3P-CZ02-DR1M90 image compatibility is UNKNOWN.
explicit_facts: The example combines a USB UVC camera, NPU and HDMI display for face detection.
It references a dr1m90_npu SDK example repository and recommends bringing up display, then npu_demo, then camera examples.
pages.version_scope: No current-board kernel, Buildroot, glibc, runtime or driver version was specified.

pages.title: IPUG166_Video_NPU_IP用户手册
pages.applicability: Document names target DR1M90GEG484-2 and TD 5.9.1 Beta1.0; this differs from the current MLK-F3P-CZ02-DR1M90 board identity and therefore is not a verified match.

The text lists YOLOv3-tiny/v3/v4/v5s and Mobilefacenet, with int8/uint8 quantization.

pages.title: APUG1205_NPU参考设计文档
pages.applicability: Document describes the DR1 family HardNPU/SoftNPU architecture; exact MLK-F3P-CZ02-DR1M90 eMMC/runtime mapping is UNKNOWN.
explicit_facts: The page describes HardNPU and SoftNPU as cooperating NPU units, with SoftNPU in PL.
It lists typical networks including YOLO variants and int8/uint8 support.
The page does not expose a versioned deployable runtime package or current-board module identity in the captured content.

global_findings.softnpu_hardware_engine_or_bitstream: The D20.1 page documents generating an HPF/bitstream and names an example HPF filename, but no downloadable HPF/bitstream URL, size, SHA256 or current-board mapping was exposed by the public API.
global_findings.linux_and_buildroot: D20.1 names a DR1M90 Buildroot defconfig, kernelmenuconfig NPU module selections and rootfs sizing; it does not prove those changes are present in the current eMMC image.
global_findings.drivers_or_modules: The Wiki documents selecting hard_npu_driver, soft_npu_driver and cma_mem_driver, but no .ko download or vermagic was exposed.
global_findings.runtime_and_headers: D20.0 documents API symbols and CMA/NPUExecutor usage, but no versioned standalone npu_runtime library/header package or ABI matrix was exposed.
global_findings.one_shot_and_models: The selected pages did not expose an official one-shot ELF, rt.bin, weight.bin, model hash or complete public download URL.
global_findings.host_tools: No convert_tool or al_ai_flow executable/package URL was exposed by the selected pages.
global_findings.license_and_access: No explicit license, account requirement or download permission for the referenced file-list assets was exposed by the public API.

current_board_contract.reason: Selected example assets target AD101V20 or DR1M90GEG484-2, and no current eMMC bitstream/module/runtime identity is exposed.
